title: Brake Inspection Standard: Pad Minimum, Fluid Test and Inspection Validity by Line
content:
**Pad minimum thickness.** For Brake Service Warranties, a pad thickness at or below the line's pad minimum thickness means the pads are worn to minimum and must be replaced. The minimum is 3.0 mm on every line except the Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty, where it is 4.0 mm.

| Brake service line | Pad minimum thickness | Free brake inspection | Measured inspection starts every warranty visit | Inspection usable for | Brake fluid moisture test in every inspection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 3.0 mm | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | 3.0 mm | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | 3.0 mm | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | 3.0 mm | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | 3.0 mm | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 4.0 mm | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | Yes |

**Column meanings.**
- *Free brake inspection* — a brake inspection is free at any Crestline store.
- *Measured inspection starts every warranty visit* — every warranty visit starts with a measured inspection.
- *Inspection usable for* — the calendar days an inspection remains usable as the basis of a warranty visit.
- *Brake fluid moisture test in every inspection* — a moisture test of the brake fluid is part of every inspection.

**Reading the pad minimum on both sides.**

| Thinnest pad measured, compared with the line's minimum | Worn to minimum? |
|---|---|
| Thinner than the minimum | Yes |
| Exactly equal to the minimum | Yes — "at or below" includes equality |
| Thicker than the minimum | No |

A reading that would count as worn to minimum on the Severe-Duty line, where the minimum is 4.0 mm, may be above the 3.0 mm minimum of the other lines; the minimum is always the one of the line the warranty belongs to.
